description: The injected logging abstraction whose category is the fully qualified name of `T`.
A component that receives log messages and writes them somewhere, such as the console, the debugger or a log backend.
A string attached to every message from a logger, usually the class name, used to filter levels in configuration.
A log format string with named placeholders that are filled by argument position and kept as structured fields.
Logging that stores each placeholder value as a separate field, so logs can be queried by value instead of parsed as text.
The severity of a message, from `Trace` (0) to `Critical` (5), with `None` (6) disabling a category.
A block opened with `BeginScope` that attaches the same fields to every message logged inside it.
The `[LoggerMessage]` attribute on a `partial` method, which generates allocation-light logging code at compile time.
